# forestData

The goal of `forestData` is to simplify importing of Canadian forestry
data, including:

- National Ecosystem Framework for Canada
  (<https://sis.agr.gc.ca/cansis/nsdb/ecostrat/gis_data.html>);
- Common Attribute Schema for Forest Resource Inventories (CASFRI;
  <https://casfri.github.io/CASFRI/>);
- National Terrestrial Ecosystem Monitoring System (NTEMS,
  <https://opendata.nfis.org/mapserver/nfis-change_eng.html>);
- Satellite-Based Forest Inventory (SBFI) and the Spatialized Canadian
  National Forest Inventory (SCANFI).

## Installation

You can install the development version of `forestData` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/FOR-CAST/forestData) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("FOR-CAST/forestData")
```

`pak` reads the `Remotes:` field, so the GitHub-only dependencies
(`spatialutils`, `workflowtools`) are installed automatically.

## Examples

See the `CASFRI-examples` and `NTEMS-examples` vignettes.

# Package index

## Package

- [`forestData`](https://for-cast.github.io/forestData/reference/forestData-package.md)
  [`forestData-package`](https://for-cast.github.io/forestData/reference/forestData-package.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Tools for Importing Canadian Forestry Data

## Forest inventory data

Download and prepare Canadian forest inventory products for a study
area.

- [`ntems()`](https://for-cast.github.io/forestData/reference/ntems.md)
  : NTEMS data
- [`scanfi()`](https://for-cast.github.io/forestData/reference/scanfi.md)
  : SCANFI data
- [`prep_species_layers_sbfi()`](https://for-cast.github.io/forestData/reference/prep_species_layers_sbfi.md)
  : Prepare species-layer rasters from SBFI data
- [`casfri_species_cover()`](https://for-cast.github.io/forestData/reference/casfri-species.md)
  [`casfri_species_cover.list()`](https://for-cast.github.io/forestData/reference/casfri-species.md)
  [`casfri_species_cover.PqConnection()`](https://for-cast.github.io/forestData/reference/casfri-species.md)
  [`casfri_species_layers()`](https://for-cast.github.io/forestData/reference/casfri-species.md)
  : CASFRI species cover data

## Ecological boundaries

National ecological framework polygons.

- [`.ecoboundaries()`](https://for-cast.github.io/forestData/reference/ecoboundaries.md)
  [`ecodistricts()`](https://for-cast.github.io/forestData/reference/ecoboundaries.md)
  [`ecoregions()`](https://for-cast.github.io/forestData/reference/ecoboundaries.md)
  [`ecoprovinces()`](https://for-cast.github.io/forestData/reference/ecoboundaries.md)
  [`ecozones()`](https://for-cast.github.io/forestData/reference/ecoboundaries.md)
  : National eco-boundaries
